stock.title: Stock
stock.description: What is on your shelves right now, its value at cost and at MRP, and what needs reordering.
stock.search_placeholder: Search name, SKU or scan barcode
stock.expired_alert_one: {{count}} batch has expired and is still on the shelf.
stock.expired_alert_other: {{count}} batches have expired and are still on the shelf.
stock.empty_description: Enter the stock you have today as opening stock — scan items or paste them from Excel. After that, every sale and purchase updates stock automatically.
stock.none_hint: Try another search, store or filter.

by_batch.none_hint: Stock appears here after opening stock, a purchase or a transfer.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.description: Every sale, purchase, return, adjustment and transfer that changed stock, with the balance after it.
movements.none_hint: Movements appear when you sell, buy, adjust or transfer stock.

batches.title: Batches & expiry
batches.description: Batches with stock by expiry date — clear expired stock and sell or return near-expiry stock in time.
batches.none_d30: Nothing expires in the next 30 days
batches.none_d60: Nothing expires in the next 60 days
batches.none_d90: Nothing expires in the next 90 days
batches.none_hint: Good — check the next window too.
batches.none_all_hint: Batches are created when you buy or enter opening stock of batch-tracked items.
batches.dates_need_adjust: Only users who can adjust stock may change dates.
batches.active_hint: Inactive batches are not offered for billing.
batches.stale: Someone else changed this batch just now. The latest details are loaded — please check and edit again.

adjustments.title: Stock adjustments
adjustments.description: Corrections, stock takes, damaged and expired stock written off — each with its value.
adjustments.empty_description: Count your shelves with a stock take, or record damaged, expired or missing goods so the stock and accounts stay correct.
adjustments.editor_description: Scan or search items, enter the change or the counted quantity, then post.
adjustments.store_locked: Remove all items to change the store.
adjustments.notes_placeholder: e.g. Rain water leak in godown

empty_lines.stock_take: Load a category or scan items to count

adjustments.empty_lines_hint: Use the barcode scanner or type a product name above.
adjustments.estimate_note: Estimated at current cost; losses are valued at average cost when posted.

account.inventory_adjustment: Losses go to Stock adjustment in accounts.
account.inventory_writeoff: Losses go to Stock written off in accounts.

adjustments.nothing_to_post: Add at least one item with a quantity to post.
adjustments.confirm_post_final: Stock and accounts are updated now; a posted adjustment can only be cancelled, not edited.
adjustments.stale: This draft was changed elsewhere. Reload the page to see the latest version.
adjustments.delete_description: The draft and its items are removed. Stock is not affected.
adjustments.cancel_description: The stock changes and the accounting entry are reversed. This cannot be undone.
adjustments.no_movements: No stock movements for this document.

stock_take.load_hint: Load every item of a category (or the whole store) with its system stock, then type what you count.
stock_take.too_many: Only the first {{max}} items were loaded. Count the rest in another stock take.
stock_take.scan_hint: Each scan of an item adds 1 to its count. Type in the count box to correct it; Enter moves to the next item.
stock_take.uncounted_note_one: {{count}} item is not counted yet — it will be left unchanged.
stock_take.uncounted_note_other: {{count}} items are not counted yet — they will be left unchanged.
stock_take.save_uncounted_description: Only counted items are saved in the draft. Count the others before saving if you want to keep them in the list.

lines.add_placeholder: Scan barcode or search product to add
lines.scan_hint: Scan or search an item, type the quantity and press Enter to add the next one.

opening.title: Opening stock
opening.description: Enter the stock you have today. Cost is per pack, without GST.
opening.paste_hint: Columns: barcode or SKU, quantity, cost, batch, expiry, MRP. A header row is optional.
opening.paste_empty: Nothing to add — paste rows copied from Excel.

paste_issue.bad_expiry: Row {{line}}: expiry “{{value}}” is not a date

opening.empty_title: Scan or search the first item
opening.empty_hint: Each item gets a row: type the quantity, press Enter, check the cost, and scan the next one.
opening.confirm_description: Stock worth {{amount}} is added and an opening balance entry is made in accounts.
opening.has_movements_description: {{names}} — already sold, bought or adjusted in this store. Adding opening stock again may count it twice. Post anyway?

transfers.title: Stock transfers
transfers.description: Send stock from one store to another and confirm when it arrives.
transfers.empty_description: Move stock to another store: pick the items, dispatch, and the other store confirms what it received.
transfers.editor_description: Choose the stores, add the items to send, then dispatch.
transfers.no_destinations: There is no other active store to send stock to.
transfers.more_than_stock: More than the stock at the source store
transfers.empty_lines_hint: Scan or search items available at the source store.
transfers.notes_placeholder: e.g. Sent by auto with Kumar
transfers.no_lines: Add at least one item to the transfer.
transfers.value_note: Value at the source store's average cost.
transfers.confirm_dispatch_description_one: {{count}} item worth {{amount}} leaves {{from}} for {{to}}. The stock is taken out of the source store now.
transfers.confirm_dispatch_description_other: {{count}} items worth {{amount}} leave {{from}} for {{to}}. The stock is taken out of the source store now.
transfers.stale: This draft was changed elsewhere. Reload the page to see the latest version.
transfers.cancel_draft_description: The draft is closed. Stock is not affected.
transfers.cancel_dispatched_description: The stock goes back to the source store. This cannot be undone.
transfers.awaiting_receipt: On the way — {{store}} will confirm the received quantities.
transfers.receive_description: Check the goods and enter what actually arrived. Anything short is written off at the source store.
transfers.shortfall_placeholder: e.g. 2 bags torn on the way
transfers.shortfall_reason_required: Tell us why some items are short.
transfers.shortfall_note: Shortfall written off at the source store:

print.title: Stock transfer note
print.not_invoice: Transfer of goods between branches of the same business — not a tax invoice

cancel.reason_hint: Kept with the document and in the audit log.

validation.duplicate_line: This item (and batch) is already in the list
validation.batch_ambiguous: Choose an existing batch or enter a new one, not both
validation.batch_dates: Expiry date must be after the manufacturing date
validation.transfer_same_store: Choose a different store to send to
validation.date_order: The start date must not be after the end date
validation.future_date: The date cannot be in the future
validation.received_exceeds_dispatched: Received quantity cannot be more than what was sent
validation.unknown_line: This item is not part of the transfer
validation.received_before_dispatch: Received date cannot be before the transfer date

errors.not_draft: Only drafts can be changed. Reload to see the latest status.
errors.not_posted: Only posted adjustments can be cancelled.
errors.not_dispatched: Only dispatched transfers can be received.
errors.already_received: A received transfer cannot be cancelled.
errors.empty_document: Add at least one item first.
errors.has_movements: Some items already have stock entries in this store.
errors.not_stock_item: This item does not keep stock (service or stock tracking off).
errors.batch_not_allowed: This item does not use batches.
errors.batch_product_mismatch: This batch belongs to another product.
errors.all_stores_required: You need access to every store to see all stores together.
errors.expiry_change_forbidden: Only users who can adjust stock may change expiry dates.
errors.export_too_large: Too many rows to export at once. Narrow the filters and try again.
